note: Curated, hand-maintained recommended-model list for the Models page. Powers fit badges and the browse-and-install cards. VRAM figures are CONSERVATIVE estimates for the default quant with a modest (~4k) context — real usage varies with context length and KV cache. Ollama has no official library-search API, so anything not listed here is installable via the pull-by-name box.

ollama.name: llama3.2:1b
ollama.desc: Tiny, very fast Q&A model — great on constrained VRAM or as a snappy fallthrough.

ollama.name: llama3.2:3b
ollama.desc: Default Q&A model. Fast, cheap, good enough for the 'tell me a joke' conversational fallthrough.

ollama.name: qwen2.5:3b
ollama.desc: Compact Qwen — strong instruction following for its size; a solid Q&A alternative to llama3.2:3b.

ollama.name: phi3:3.8b
ollama.desc: Microsoft Phi-3 mini — punchy reasoning at a small footprint.

ollama.name: llama3.1:8b
ollama.desc: Larger general Q&A model — noticeably better answers, still comfortable on a single 4070 Ti Super.

ollama.name: qwen2.5:7b
ollama.desc: Mid-size Qwen — good schema adherence for tool routing AND capable Q&A. A balanced single-model pick.

ollama.name: mistral:7b
ollama.desc: Well-rounded 7B general model — fast and widely compatible.

ollama.name: gemma2:9b
ollama.desc: Google Gemma 2 — strong quality per parameter; a step up from the 7B tier.

ollama.name: qwen2.5:14b
ollama.desc: Default tool-routing model. Strong function-calling / schema adherence — what matters for reliable command dispatch.

ollama.name: qwen2.5-coder:7b
ollama.desc: Code/structured-output tuned Qwen — a lighter tool-router when 14b is too heavy for the free VRAM.

ollama.name: qwen2.5:32b
ollama.desc: Large Qwen — top-tier routing + reasoning, but needs serious VRAM (or a multi-GPU split).

ollama.name: nomic-embed-text:latest
ollama.desc: Embedding model required by Letta chat mode's archival/recall memory. Tiny; pull it before enabling chat.

whisper.name: tiny
whisper.accuracy: lowest — fine for quiet, close-mic English commands
whisper.desc: Fastest, smallest Whisper. Real-time on almost anything.

whisper.name: base
whisper.accuracy: low — better than tiny, still light
whisper.desc: A small step up from tiny at negligible extra cost.

whisper.name: small
whisper.accuracy: moderate — good general-purpose choice on modest GPUs
whisper.desc: The value pick when large-v3 is overkill.

whisper.name: medium
whisper.desc: Strong accuracy; a middle ground between small and large.

whisper.name: large-v3
whisper.desc: Best transcription quality. The Domovoi server's default STT model.

whisper.name: large-v3
whisper.desc: large-v3 at int8: roughly half the VRAM, near-identical accuracy. Set whisper_compute_type=int8.

whisper.name: distil-large-v3
whisper.desc: Distilled large-v3: most of the accuracy at a fraction of the compute.

whisper.name: large-v3-turbo
whisper.desc: Turbo variant of large-v3 — much faster decode with a small accuracy trade.
